fields.description: District One West is a gated villa community beside the Crystal Lagoon in Mohammed Bin Rashid Al Maktoum City. Garden villas and larger lagoon-facing homes offer different layouts, levels and relationships to the water. The development is delivered in phases, so a property’s phase and architectural type matter as much as its bedroom count.
amenities: School and nursery facilities in the community plan

research.community: District One West · District One · Mohammed Bin Rashid Al Maktoum City
overview: The current developer microsite distinguishes four-bedroom Garden Villas, five-bedroom Lagoon Villas and six-bedroom Island Villas. The earlier plan pack also includes seven-bedroom Island homes. Collection labels and specifications should therefore be checked against the phase rather than assumed interchangeable.
For the four-bedroom A1 drawing, the printed built-up and total areas differ: the total additionally includes pergola garage and roof terrace areas. Neither figure is a plot size.
research.locationNote: Nakheel locates District One West within Mohammed Bin Rashid Al Maktoum City, District One. The local location taxonomy has no exact Mohammed Bin Rashid City entry yet; areaId remains null.
research.priceNote: A current official starting price was not found. Property Finder reports AED 12,781,571 in its FAQ but marks developer stock out of stock and does not establish a phase or currently allocatable unit. It is not promoted as a developer starting quote.
research.paymentNote: Property Finder reports 20% at launch, 60% during construction and 20% handover. This totals 100% but is a portal summary, not a reviewed current signed developer schedule. Exact dates, phase and transfer balances remain to confirm.
research.handoverNote: Property Finder reports March 2027. Nakheel separately tracks phase 1 and phase 2 and does not give a single contractual completion date in the reviewed progress page. The year is retained as an estimate; confirm the selected phase and unit.
